scripts.predev: docker compose up -d || echo '[INFO] Docker unavailable, using local DB...' && fuser -k 8000/tcp 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.dev: concurrently -c "cyan,magenta,blue,green" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,TELEGRAM,OPENCLAW" "bash -c 'set -a && source .env && set +a && source venv/bin/activate && PYTHONPATH=. uvicorn apps.backend.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload'" "cd apps/frontend && pnpm dev" "bash -c 'sleep 4 && set -a && source .env && set +a && source venv/bin/activate && PYTHONPATH=. python -m apps.telegram_bot.bot'" "openclaw gateway"
scripts.stop: fuser -k 8000/tcp 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'next dev' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f telegram_bot 2>/dev/null; pkill -f openclaw 2>/dev/null; echo 'All AIMS services stopped.'
scripts.db:migrate: bash -c 'set -a && source .env && set +a && source venv/bin/activate && PYTHONPATH=. alembic upgrade head'
scripts.db:seed: bash -c 'set -a && source .env && set +a && source venv/bin/activate && PYTHONPATH=. python scripts/seed.py'
